subject: general
question:
In the following diagram, L represents educated people, M represents illiterate people, N represents working people. Which number represents people who are working and illiterate? 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2c75f6171591edfa17a615138757b4264dc3bd738c633c59b466bcdcbb391be7.png]
solution:
The Venn diagram is given below:-

The L represents educated people,

The M represents illiterate people.

The N represents working people.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/81d5c16dc5042ba6428604d1fb39be2485aaf92cc518e307e44e39bd59677aff.png] 

 
• The shaded part shows represent people who are working and illiterate is 4.

Hence, **"option 1"** is the correct answer.
